title: 5 Concorde Place, #611, Toronto, Condo for sale
description:
Welcome to 5 Concorde Place, a well-maintained condominium building steps away from conservation lands, the Don River and the East Don Trail, as well as numerous amenities for residents’ enjoyment.

Unit 611 offers spacious living areas and beautiful views of the nearby natural landscape.

Off the front foyer, a galley-style kitchen with overhead panel lighting has a wall cutout to maintain an openness to the adjacent dining area.

New laminate flooring flows throughout most of the unit, and the open concept dining and living rooms, a graciously sized combined space, are ideal for entertaining friends and family, while a large window allows for abundant natural light and a great view of the conservation land. 

The same stunning view can be enjoyed through floor to ceiling windows in the adjacent sun-filled den area, where a sliding door separates the space, allowing for use as a second bedroom. 

This building has many fantastic amenities, including tennis, squash and racquetball courts; swimming pool, whirlpool, sauna and steam room; a well-equipped gym; library and card room; party and meeting rooms; a billiards room; a video theatre; and 24 hr concierge.

This unit has plenty of storage space, including the front foyer’s spacious triple door closet, as well as a large storage room with an ensuite laundry area, and also features a 3-pc washroom with glass-enclosed shower.

The huge master bedroom has his and her double closets, a window overlooking the nearby ravine and parklands, and a 4-pc ensuite with separate shower and bath areas.

Ideal for commuters, this condo has quick access to the DVP and is just a short drive to Union Station and downtown Toronto, is steps away from TTC access, and is also close to the Ontario Science Centre, the Shops at Don Mills, Donaldo Golf Club, and the Aga Khan Museum.

For more information, contact Tom Sachdeva, of Re/Max Dynasty Realty Inc., at (647) 299-4529.
author: Open House 24
